# Boss Draft

Draft on boss walls and their holes, which replaces the general draft rule there.

<figure markdown="span">
![Boss Draft: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-boss-draft-light.svg#only-light){ width="640" }
![Boss Draft: on the left what to avoid, on the right what to aim for](../../assets/diagrams/min-boss-draft-dark.svg#only-dark){ width="640" }
<figcaption>Draft on boss walls and, at half the limits, on the holes in them; replaces the general draft rule there.</figcaption>
</figure>

## Where it applies

| Process | Criticality |
| :-- | :-- |
| [Plastic Injection Molding](../../reference/processes/plastic-injection-molding.md) | High |

## Values

**Aim for** is what to design for; crossing it gives a warning. **At least** is the hard limit; crossing it gives an error. See [aim for and limits](../../concepts/aim-for-and-limits.md).

Criticality in this process: **High** ([what this means](../../concepts/criticality.md)).

| Material | Aim for | At least | Source |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| **Default** | 1.0° outside (half for the hole) | 0.5° outside (half for the hole) | Not yet sourced |

Every other material uses the Default values: PLA, ABS, Acetal / POM, PMMA, LCP, Long-Fiber Reinforced Plastics, PA, PC, PET / PBT, PE, PSU, PP, PS, PUR, PVC.

## Messages

What the results panel says about a finding. You can rewrite these in the Process Library; the words in `{braces}` are filled in for each finding.

!!! warning "Warning"

    Little Boss Draft (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under the recommended `{target}`. Bosses, and the pins that core their holes, need draft to release cleanly. Add a little more draft.
!!! failure "Error"

    Boss Draft Too Small (`{measured}`): `{feature}` is `{size}`, under `{limit}`. It will drag on ejection: expect scuffed walls, a boss pulled out of round, or a part held on its core pin. Draft it by `{target}` or more.
| Placeholder | Replaced with |
| :-- | :-- |
| `{measured}` | The measured value, with its unit |
| `{target}` | The rule's "Aim for" value |
| `{limit}` | The rule's "At least" value |
| `{feature}` | What it is about, such as "Boss 3 (screw)" or "Face12" |
| `{size}` | Its size or what was found, such as "Ø3.00 mm and 9.00 mm deep" |
